description: Complete the Genie Instructions that disambiguate common business terms.
expectedOutput:
When completed correctly, this configuration will:
1. Disambiguate 'revenue' to use the net_revenue metric view (not gross)
2. Define 'active user' as 30-day logged-in (not all-time)
3. Specify the date grain for 'last quarter' (calendar quarter, not 90 days)
4. Reference the cohort function for retention questions
5. Direct Genie to the trusted assets whitelist
codeTemplate:
-- Genie Instructions for an e-commerce Genie Space
-- These run as plain-English context for NL→SQL translation

INSTRUCTIONS = [
    -- Disambiguate 'revenue' to use the governed metric view
    "When users ask about __BLANK_0__, use the metric view analytics.metrics.net_revenue, "
    "not gold.orders.gross_revenue. Net revenue = gross - discounts - returns.",

    -- Define 'active user' precisely
    "'Active user' means __BLANK_1__ in the last 30 days. "
    "Use the trusted function analytics.fn.is_active_user(user_id, days_back).",

    -- Specify date grain for vague terms
    "'Last quarter' means the most recent completed __BLANK_2__, not the last 90 days. "
    "Always filter on DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date).",

    -- Reference cohort function
    "For retention questions, call the trusted function __BLANK_3__(start_date, cohort_days).",

    -- Direct to trusted assets only
    "Only query tables in the __BLANK_4__ list. Reject questions about other tables."
]

TRUSTED_ASSETS = [
    'analytics.metrics.net_revenue',
    'analytics.metrics.customer_ltv',
    'analytics.metrics.churn_rate',
    'analytics.fn.is_active_user',
    'analytics.fn.cohort_retention'
]
hints: Revenue is the most commonly-ambiguous term in analytics — always specify the metric view
Active user definitions vary by company (DAU, MAU, WAU, logged-in, purchased)
'Last quarter' can mean calendar quarter, fiscal quarter, or rolling 90 days — be explicit
Trusted functions are the way to expose custom Python/SQL computations to Genie
Trusted Assets is the whitelist — Genie cannot see anything not in this list
learnings: Genie Instructions are plain-English, not SQL
Each instruction should answer one ambiguity
Reference metric views and trusted functions by their full UC path
Date-grain ambiguity is one of the top NL→SQL failure modes
The Trusted Assets list is the security boundary — review it carefully
